text.p: Penn Traffic Co said on Tuesday that assuming current profit trends, it expects earnings before interest, taxes, depreciaiton and amortization in the fourth quarter to be the highest of the four quarters of the current year.
The company also said that as it begins to see benefits from its grocery department merchandising enhancements, it expects to see continued improvement in the first half of fiscal 1998.
Penn Traffic reported a loss of $1.46 a share for the third quarter ended November 2, compared with a loss of $0.03 a share the previous third quarter.
Third quarter EBITDA was $35.0 million versus $52.8 million.
The company said that its gross margins have improved since mid-September and that it has been able to "refine" the ongoing costs of its repositioning program.
